def VTask.prevFixed {α : Type u} [CompleteLattice α] (f : α →o α) (x : α) (hx : f x ≤ x) : ↑(Function.fixedPoints f) :=
  let g : α →o α :=
    { toFun := fun y => if y ≤ x then f y else x,
      monotone' := by
        intro y z h
        by_cases hz : z ≤ x
        · have hy : y ≤ x := le_trans h hz
          rw [if_pos hy, if_pos hz]
          exact f.monotone h
        · have g_z_eq_x : g.toFun z = x := by rw [if_neg hz]
          have g_y_le_x : g.toFun y ≤ x := by
            by_cases hy : y ≤ x
            · rw [if_pos hy]
              exact le_trans (f.monotone (le_trans h hy)) hx
            · rw [if_neg hy]
              exact le_rfl
          exact le_of_eq g_z_eq_x g_y_le_x }
  let p : α := g.gfp
  have h_p_eq_g_p : p = g p := g.gfp_fixed
  have h_p_le_x : p ≤ x := by
    by_contra h
    have g_p_eq_x : g p = x := by rw [h_p_eq_g_p]; simp [g.toFun, h]
    rw [h_p_eq_g_p] at g_p_eq_x
    exact absurd (le_antisymm g_p_eq_x (le_refl x)) h
  have h_p_eq_f_p : p = f p := by
    rw [h_p_eq_g_p]
    simp [g.toFun, h_p_le_x]
    rfl
  ⟨p, h_p_eq_f_p⟩
